question: Who launched the Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam 2.0 campaign?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Dharmendra Pradhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister Dharmendra Pradhan launches Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam 2.0 campaign.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** planted a sapling and launched the **Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam 2.0** campaign in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
Launched a **special module** and **website** for Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam 2.0, including a **web portal** to monitor eco clubs under **Mission Life**.

 
 
• 
 
Emphasized the **importance of trees** for the survival of all living beings.

 
 
• 
 
Stressed the need to prepare future generations to achieve **Net Zero by 2070**.

 
 
• 
 
Highlighted the problem of **plastic pollution**: **400 million tonnes of plastic are produced annually**, but only **10% is recycled**.

 
 
• 
 
Called for the adoption of **sustainable development practices** to conserve the environment.
